guided_browser_verification.reproduce: npm ci && npx playwright install chromium && node public/proofs/conversation-resolution/test-guide-browser.cjs
guided_browser_verification.method: Real browser navigation to HTTP-served source with CSP enforced; not set_content or a CSP bypass.
guided_browser_verification.coverage: Initial disclosure, contextual steps, keyboard focus, owner acceptance, escalation, four scenarios, guarded closure, reopening, read-only back navigation, export and responsive layout.
guided_browser_verification.release_rule: Inspect the successful exact-head guided-browser job and retained results before accepting a release. Public HTTPS delivery is checked separately after deployment; this manifest alone does not assert that either check passed.
